differential.name: Diabetic kidney disease (microalbuminuria)
differential.rationale: Critical microalbumin/creatinine ratio (13.3 mg/g) in a patient with longstanding T2DM, hypertension, and metabolic syndrome indicates early diabetic nephropathy.

differential.name: Acute viral infection‑associated thrombocytopenia
differential.rationale: Recent viral sinusitis/pharyngitis can cause transient platelet drops; platelet count 42 ×10³/µL fits this pattern.

differential.name: Drug‑induced thrombocytopenia
differential.rationale: Polypharmacy common in metabolic syndrome; many agents (e.g., heparin, antibiotics, antihypertensives) can precipitate immune‑mediated platelet loss.

differential.name: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP)
differential.rationale: Isolated severe thrombocytopenia without other cytopenias; could be primary autoimmune process.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Age >60, anemia history, and new severe thrombocytopenia raise concern for a clonal marrow disorder.
